note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and variable assignments. It defines a GLIP model with Swin-T backbone, FPN neck, and ATSS head for grounded object detection on COCO. There are no callable functions, classes, or APIs — it is declarative config consumed by MMDetection's config system.
config_description: GLIP model config using Swin-T backbone, FPN neck, ATSSVLFusionHead, and BERT language model for open-vocabulary grounded object detection pre-trained on Objects365
key_components: FPN feature pyramid neck with 256 output channels
COCO detection dataset with 1x training schedule
example_usages: run mmdetection training using this GLIP Swin-T config for grounded object detection on COCO
run mmdetection inference with this GLIP config to detect objects from text queries
modify the SwinTransformer backbone embed_dims and depths in this GLIP config
change the ATSSVLFusionHead num_classes to match a custom dataset in this config
swap the BERT language model name to a different pretrained model in this config
